# Baseball-Reference.com

> Comprehensive baseball statistics database covering Major League Baseball and minor leagues, with historical data, player analytics, and Stathead subscription tools.

Baseball-Reference.com is part of the Sports Reference family of sites, founded by Sean Forman and based in Philadelphia. The platform provides extensive baseball statistics, historical records, season reviews, and advanced analytics tools through its Stathead subscription service.

## Key Topics

- Major League Baseball
- Baseball statistics and analytics
- Minor league baseball
- Stathead subscription tools
- Historical sports data
- Player rankings and analytics
- Season reviews and trends
- Sports Reference network
- MLB team statistics
- Baseball-Reference.com
- Sean Forman
- Baseball database
- Page views and player popularity
- Sports data aggregation
